items.title: Caterpillar Sinks Another 6%, Vertiv Down 14%, Quanta Down 12% as AI Selloff Spreads to Industrials
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCaterpillar fell 6% today as the AI selloff spread from chip and storage stocks like Western Digital to industrials like Vertiv and Quanta Services. Investors are selling Caterpillar as a data-center stock, though power generation was 15% of its 2025 sales and revenues, and the selling looks overdone.
